name: Argob
overview: The Scriptures identify Argob as a significant region east of the Jordan River, notable for its sixty cities that were part of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, a land described as the territory of giants. This area was conquered and given to the half tribe of Manasseh, with Jair, a leader from Manasseh, renaming parts of Argob after himself, demonstrating God's providential distribution of land among His people. These passages highlight God's faithfulness in fulfilling His promises and His sovereign hand in the inheritance and settlement of Israel.
